skills.label: answer a site question
skills.name: answer.site
skills.summary: Answer hours, products, makers and hikes from saved site content; confirmed sign-ups only, never prices or sales.

skills.label: write it down for later
skills.name: backlog.log
skills.summary: Nothing fits: write the request down, say I can't do that yet, change nothing.

skills.label: put a dated banner across the top
skills.name: front.banner
skills.summary: Schedule one short line across the top of home and hike, with an optional own-site link.

skills.label: add, edit or remove a question and answer
skills.name: front.faq
skills.summary: Add or edit a question and answer on Questions, or remove a question; the first entry shows the page.

skills.label: fill or hide a fixed template page
skills.name: front.page
skills.summary: Fill or hide About, Getting here, Our policies or Questions using the owner's words and a fixed template.

skills.label: move or hide a home page part
skills.name: front.sections
skills.summary: Reorder the four home parts, hide why we do it or newsletter, or put the original order back.

skills.label: add a hike
skills.name: hike.add
skills.summary: Put a new hike on the hike page: day, time and where to meet. Sign-up stays off unless you say so.

skills.label: cancel a hike
skills.name: hike.cancel
skills.summary: Cancel a scheduled hike, with an optional one-line note on the page. Nobody is told.

skills.label: change a hike
skills.name: hike.edit
skills.summary: Change a scheduled hike: its name, where to meet, how hard, what to bring, or sign-up.

skills.label: write down how a hike went
skills.name: hike.recap
skills.summary: Mark a hike that has happened as done and keep your words on how it went.

skills.label: run a hike again
skills.name: hike.repeat
skills.summary: Copy a hike onto a new day and time: its name, text, route and sign-up setting.

skills.label: move a hike to another day or time
skills.name: hike.reschedule
skills.summary: Move a scheduled hike to a new day or time. Guests who signed up are not told.

skills.label: add a new product
skills.name: item.add
skills.summary: Add a new product from a photo and a few words: its maker if new, the picture, and whether it is in stock.

skills.label: change a product
skills.name: item.edit
skills.summary: Change a product's name, description, maker or shelf. Prices are not kept on the website.

skills.label: hide a product
skills.name: item.hide
skills.summary: Take one or more products off the website. Nothing is deleted; they can come back.

skills.label: change a product's picture
skills.name: item.picture
skills.summary: Put the photo he sent on one product, with a caption that says what it shows.

skills.label: bring a hidden product back
skills.name: item.restore
skills.summary: Put one or more hidden products back on the website.

skills.label: add a maker
skills.name: maker.add
skills.summary: Add a maker with their town and a short about text; with no story, one line says where they are based.

skills.label: change a maker or their about text
skills.name: maker.edit
skills.summary: Change a maker's name, town, about text or website link; a new story replaces the whole text.

skills.label: stop carrying a maker
skills.name: maker.hide
skills.summary: Hide a maker, and with your yes their products too; nothing is deleted.

skills.label: bring a maker back
skills.name: maker.restore
skills.summary: Bring a hidden maker back; their products come back one by one when you ask.

skills.label: change the store story
skills.name: page.about
skills.summary: Change the “Come on in” story on the home page. For the separate About template use front.page.

skills.label: add a questions page
skills.name: page.faq
skills.summary: The site has no FAQ page and a new page is a design change: say so and write it down.

skills.label: change the home page headline or intro
skills.name: page.home
skills.summary: Change the two-line headline or the intro on the home page, or put the shop's own words back.

skills.label: change the home page photo
skills.name: page.photo
skills.summary: Use the photo he sent as the home page photo, or put the shop's own photo back.

skills.label: morning shelf report
skills.name: report.shelf
skills.summary: Say what is sold out or running low from the last shelf check, and any hikes. Not stock counts; sends nothing.

skills.label: change the phone number or the address
skills.name: shop.contact
skills.summary: Change or remove the store phone number, or change the street address and town.

skills.label: change the store hours
skills.name: shop.hours
skills.summary: Change the opening hours. Days he did not name keep exactly what the site says now.

skills.label: put up a notice on the home page
skills.name: shop.notice
skills.summary: Put up, replace or take down the one dated notice at the top of the home page.

skills.label: write a post caption for a hike
skills.name: social.hike
skills.summary: Write an announcement caption for one upcoming hike, to copy. Nothing is posted or sent.

skills.label: write a post caption for a product
skills.name: social.item
skills.summary: Write an Instagram caption for one product on the website, to copy. Nothing is posted.

skills.label: write a post caption for a maker
skills.name: social.maker
skills.summary: Write a meet-the-maker caption for one maker with a story, to copy. Nothing is posted.

skills.label: write a post caption from a hike recap
skills.name: social.recap
skills.summary: Write a caption from the owner's saved recap of a hike that happened, to copy. Nothing is posted.

skills.label: put something on special
skills.name: specials.add
skills.summary: Put an item or a deal in this week's specials box on the home page, shown until a last day.

skills.label: clear the finished specials
skills.name: specials.clear_expired
skills.summary: Tidy the saved list by dropping specials whose last day has passed. They no longer show on the page.

skills.label: change a special
skills.name: specials.edit
skills.summary: Change one special: its title, deal line, product, first day or last day (for example extend it).

skills.label: take a special off
skills.name: specials.remove
skills.summary: Take one special off the home page before its last day.

skills.label: show this week's specials
skills.name: specials.show
skills.summary: Say which specials are on now and which are coming up, with each deal as it was typed.

skills.label: record the shelf check
skills.name: stock.checked
skills.summary: Record that the shelves were checked today (or a day this week), with what was found.

skills.label: stop showing a word on a product
skills.name: stock.clear
skills.summary: Take the in stock, low or sold out label off a product's card. Never sets sold out.

skills.label: record when more is coming
skills.name: stock.restock
skills.summary: Note the day more of one product is expected. A day only; never a count, never the shelf word.

skills.label: change what's in stock
skills.name: stock.set
skills.summary: Mark one or more products in stock, low, or sold out after today's shelf check.
